g.text: A partial navigation orbit rises from the lower-left while the castle and moon remain unobstructed.
The hero anchor collapses to a quarter-orbit; world prompts appear as temporary coordinate locks.
The Orrery Ring keeps the battlefield open; compact reduces it to two arcs and one expanded callout.
A Select · X Clear · B Escape
A Select · X Clear · B Escape
The preparation orbit becomes a combat timeline while both celestial anchors remain spatially stable.
Hero attacks for 24 · Goblin is Weakened
Equipment orbits the character anchor; the readable item catalogue remains a conventional deployable rail.
LB/RB Page · A Equip · B Close
The game remains visible but inert; Resume is the safe initial focus.
Standard uses a left rail; compact uses a top page selector with a fixed action row.
Save records sit on a navigable star-chart trajectory; the focused record expands without hiding metadata.
NPC identity, long text, and choices share a bottom interaction surface without losing the scene context.
The old seal has begun to stir.
Will you help us restore it?
The old seal has begun to stir.
Will you help us restore it?
Player and merchant form opposing anchors; the transaction catalogue deploys between them as a readable rail.
A small service modal communicates NPC identity, current status, cost, and disabled reasons.
The sigil-framed surface keeps prompt, choices, validation, and cancellation together.
Which light remains when moon and sun are hidden?
Which light remains when moon and sun are hidden?
Important rewards illuminate as a temporary constellation before the gold continuation seal appears.
The parent remains visible and inert; destructive intent requires explicit confirmation and safe default focus.
Recoverable and blocking errors use the same semantic shell with different actions and lifecycle policy.
The selected save could not be loaded.
The selected save could not be loaded.
